coverage_sensitivity.evidence_note: Of 9742 movies, 200 received metadata enrichment (2.053% coverage). Only 0 used genuine mock TMDB data (from Phase 8A catalog); the remaining 200 received simulated enrichment based on existing MovieLens fields. Coverage sensitivity analysis at granular levels (1%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 80%, 100%) requires live TMDB API access with explicit authorization. Current evidence status: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE.

temporal_validity.constraint: MovieLens interactions are historical (user ratings timestamped 1996–2018) while TMDB metadata is current. This creates a temporal mismatch: TMDB fields like overview, keywords, and genres may have been edited since the MovieLens interactions occurred.
temporal_validity.mitigation: This experiment does NOT claim to be a strict historical temporal prediction benchmark. Results should be interpreted as measuring the effect of metadata quality on recommendation model performance, not as a causal claim about what would have happened with richer metadata at the time of user interactions.
temporal_validity.recommendation: Future work should use a time-stamped metadata archive (e.g., Wikidata revision history) for truly temporal-valid experiments.
